card.name: Final piece of drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name split into several parts, such as the ending of naratriptan, mexiletine, desipramine or etravirine. It appears mostly in interaction and warning text where the drug is named again.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: The closing piece of a repeated generic drug name ending in -an or -ine.
modes.example: continue naratript<<an>> if these disturbances occur.

modes.label: Other split medical words
modes.description: A middle or end piece of a brand name or a long medical term.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage with FOTIV<<DA>> can cause severe hypertension
